N001.summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and expansion posture, light or uncertain defense and technology, moderate production. Maintain your economic and expansion focus while strengthening your ground army. Continue technology development at a moderate pace.
N001.title: Early Game Economy Focus
N001.trigger_summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and expansion posture, light or uncertain defense and technology, moderate production.

N002.summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, light or uncertain defense, moderate production, and representative units Zergling and Queen. Continue to strengthen your ground army, adding more Zerglings and possibly Roaches if you anticipate ground pressure. Maintain your economic lead and expand further if safe.
N002.title: Early-Mid Game Ground Reinforcement
N002.trigger_summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, light or uncertain defense, moderate production, and representative units Zergling and Queen.

N003.summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, production, and technology, heavy defense, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen, Overseer. Continue to strengthen your ground army, adding more Roaches and possibly transitioning to a tech like Hydralisks or Lurkers if the Protoss goes for heavy ground. Maintain your economy and consider further expansions.
N003.title: Midgame Heavy Ground Army
N003.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, production, and technology, heavy defense, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen, Overseer.

N004.summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, moderate production and technology, representative units Zergling and Queen. Continue to expand aggressively while increasing your production and defense. Strengthen your ground army with more Zerglings and Queens, and consider adding a Spore Crawler or two for defense against oracle or void ray harass.
N004.title: Early-Mid Game Aggressive Expansion
N004.trigger_summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, moderate production and technology, representative units Zergling and Queen.

N005.summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen. Maintain your current army composition while continuing to expand and upgrade. Consider adding more Roaches or transitioning to Hydralisks if you scout air units.
N005.title: Midgame Balanced Ground
N005.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen.

N006.summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense and production, heavy technology, representative units Zergling and Queen. Continue to develop your technology while maintaining your economy. Strengthen your ground army with Zerglings and Queens, and prepare to transition to your tech choice, such as Roaches or Mutalisks.
N006.title: Early-Mid Game Tech Investment
N006.trigger_summary: Early-mid game phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense and production, heavy technology, representative units Zergling and Queen.

N007.summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling and Queen. Continue to expand and increase your production. Strengthen your ground army with more Zerglings and Queens, and consider adding a Roach Warren if you anticipate ground pressure.
N007.title: Midgame Expansion and Production
N007.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling and Queen.

N008.summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, and production, moderate technology, representative units Zergling, Mutalisk, Queen. Continue to strengthen your air force, adding more Mutalisks and possibly upgrading them. Maintain your ground army for defense and continue to expand.
N008.title: Midgame Air Transition
N008.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, and production, moderate technology, representative units Zergling, Mutalisk, Queen.

N009.summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Mutalisk, Queen. Continue to increase your air force and upgrades. Maintain your ground army for defense and consider adding Corruptors to deal with heavy air threats like Void Rays or Phoenixes.
N009.title: Late-Midgame Air Superiority
N009.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Mutalisk, Queen.

N010.summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and expansion, light or uncertain defense, production, and technology, no representative units. Continue to expand and build up your economy. Start producing Queens for defense and Zerglings for scouting and early defense.
N010.title: Early Game Fast Expand
N010.trigger_summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and expansion, light or uncertain defense, production, and technology, no representative units.

N011.summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen, Overseer. Maintain your ground army and continue to upgrade. Consider adding more Roaches or transitioning to a more advanced ground unit like Lurkers or Ultralisks if the game goes late.
N011.title: Late-Midgame Heavy Ground
N011.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen, Overseer.

N012.summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen. Continue to expand and increase your production. Strengthen your ground army with more Roaches and Zerglings, and consider adding upgrades.
N012.title: Late-Midgame Aggressive Expansion
N012.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, defense, production, and technology, representative units Zergling, Roach, Queen.
